outcome_detail: $3.65 million aggregate settlement for seven plaintiffs, reached October 29, 2021 (announced early November 2021). Most of the settlement (over $2.65 million) was paid by the Boy Scouts of America's insurance; Louisville Metro Government's insurance paid less than $1 million.
criminal_detail: Three former LMPD officers named in the suits were convicted of sex-related crimes in federal court. Kenneth Betts pleaded guilty in December 2018 to enticement, attempted enticement, possession of child pornography, transfer of obscene materials to a minor, and distribution of child pornography, and was sentenced to 16 years in prison with 20 years of supervised release. Brandon Wood pleaded guilty to attempted enticement of a minor he met through the Explorer program and was sentenced in 2019 to nearly 6 years in federal prison. Bradley Schuhmann was also convicted of a sex-related federal offense.
incident_date_approx: Roughly 2011-2016, involving minors in the LMPD Explorer youth program
description: Multiple lawsuits, the first filed in March 2017, accused officers of the Louisville Metro Police Department of sexually abusing minors — including allegations of rape — who participated in the department's Explorer program, a mentorship program for teens interested in law enforcement careers. Seven plaintiffs, whose identities remain confidential, sued Louisville Metro Government and the Boy Scouts of America, which chartered the program, alleging abuse by former officers Kenneth Betts and Brandon Wood. Betts and Wood pleaded guilty to federal sex crimes, and a third former officer named in the suits, Bradley Schuhmann, was also convicted in federal court. The consolidated claims settled on October 29, 2021 for a combined $3.65 million, with most of the money paid by the Boy Scouts' insurer. The scandal led to the Explorer program's suspension and prompted Kentucky to extend the statute of limitations for child sex abuse crimes.
notes: Filed before 2021; included because resolution (October 2021 settlement) occurred in window. Multiple suits by seven plaintiffs reported and settled in aggregate ($3.65M), so kept as one record with multiple_filings=true.
